source_caption:
🎬 Stick (2025–Present)

Stick follows Pryce Cahill, a former professional golfer whose once-promising career collapsed after a devastating setback, leaving him struggling to find purpose and direction in his life. Years after leaving competitive golf behind, Pryce spends his days working at a sporting goods store while dealing with financial difficulties, personal regrets, and the painful memories of his past. His life begins changing when he discovers Santi Wheeler, a talented teenage golfer with extraordinary natural ability but little professional guidance. Recognizing the young player’s potential, Pryce sees an unexpected opportunity to return to the sport he once loved, this time as a mentor rather than a competitor. Determined to help Santi succeed, he sets out on an unpredictable journey filled with challenging tournaments, complicated relationships, hilarious situations, and emotional discoveries. However, coaching a gifted but inexperienced teenager proves far more difficult than Pryce imagined, especially as both must confront their own insecurities and personal struggles. Along the way, their unlikely partnership gradually develops into a meaningful friendship built on trust, encouragement, and shared ambition. As Santi pursues his dreams of becoming a professional golfer, Pryce begins rediscovering his confidence and understanding that success is not always measured by trophies or championships. Combining heartfelt comedy, sports drama, memorable characters, and uplifting storytelling, Stick explores mentorship, friendship, redemption, resilience, second chances, and the courage to pursue your dreams.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sports • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30–40 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Jason Keller

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Stick is an American sports comedy television series created by Jason Keller for Apple TV+ and starring Owen Wilson as a former professional golfer who takes a young prodigy under his wing to turn his life around. The series premiered on June 4, 2025. In July 2025, the series was renewed for a second season which premiered on November 4, 2026.
